edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 for the Shares, subject to adjustment only as expressly provided in this Agreement.
2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 30 days of signing, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing.
3. Representations. The Seller represents that the financial statements are accurate in all material respects, subject to the qualifications set out in this Agreement.

4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential, except as required by law or to a party’s professional advisers on a need-to-know basis, each subject to customary confidentiality obligations.
